en-US.description: MiniTool Partition Wizard Free helps users to repartition hard drive, format partition, check file system, align SSD partition, measure SSD performance, convert FAT to NTFS, and more on Windows 11/10/8/7
en-US.longDescription:
MiniTool Partition Wizard Free helps users to repartition hard drive, format partition, check file system, align SSD partition, measure SSD performance, convert FAT to NTFS, and more on Windows 11/10/8/7
Aiming to become the most powerful free partition manager in the long term, it keeps offering ever-increasing new features like Disk Benchmark and Space Analyzer to bring users the best experience.

- Create/delete partition in simple steps. Format inaccessible hard drive and convert RAW to NTFS to revive your hard drive.
- Erase the data on the partition completely and ensure that the data removed cannot be recovered by any data recovery solution.
- Combine two partitions into one without losing data. Split a hard drive into two partitions for various data saving purposes.
- Quickly convert hard drive or flash drive from FAT to NTFS without losing data so that you can handle files larger than 4GB.
- Free copy the non-system disk and partition for instant usage. While to copy OS disk/partition, use the Pro edition.
en-US.name: MiniTool Partition Wizard Free
